summary: Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline was attacked from Iraq and temporarily shut down, with multiple points struck and casualties reported. Iraq closed border crossings with Iran (Shalamche and Shib) and launched an investigation into the pipeline attacks. Hezbollah's Ali Tower tunnel network in south Lebanon was destroyed by IDF, triggering elevated multi-front readiness ahead of Rosh Hashanah.
key_points: Saudi East-West pipeline attacked from Iraq via drones, temporarily halted, damage and casualty count unconfirmed (Source: @asafroz/53341).
Iraq closed Shalamche and Shib border crossings with Iran; Iraq PM ordered investigation into pipeline attacks (Source: @naya_foriraq/90275).
IDF destroyed Hezbollah's 15-year Iranian-funded tunnel network at Ali Tower ridge in south Lebanon (Source: @pkpoi/143923).
Yemeni warplanes struck IRGC-backed Houthi positions in Dhubab and northern fronts (Source: @shin_persian/9769).
Houthis seized coastal town Dobab near Bab al-Mandeb opposite Perim island, vital for strait control (Source: @yediotnews25/134928).
US military transport aircraft observed landing in Erbil, northern Iraq (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/391063).
Saudi FM said Kingdom prefers not to respond yet, supports Iraqi investigation, reserves all options (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7075).
Germany and UAE jointly condemned Islamic Republic attacks on UAE and regional civilian infrastructure (Source: @kianmeli1/91816).

sections.executive_summary: Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline was struck by drones from Iraq and temporarily shut down, with injuries reported and damage extent unclear. Iraq closed two border crossings with Iran and opened an investigation into the attacks. IDF destroyed Hezbollah's Ali Tower tunnel network in south Lebanon, prompting unusual multi-front readiness ahead of Rosh Hashanah.

sections.threat_assessment: The coordinated drone attacks on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline from Iraq represent a significant escalation in Tehran-aligned proxy warfare against Gulf infrastructure. Iraq's border closure with Iran and simultaneous investigation into the pipeline attacks suggest Baghdad is under pressure to act against Iranian-backed groups while managing bilateral tensions. The destruction of Hezbollah's Ali Tower tunnel network by IDF raises the risk of northern escalation ahead of Rosh Hashanah, with IDF preparing multi-scenario readiness. Houthi consolidation at Dobab near Bab al-Mandeb, reportedly Iran-directed, threatens maritime security and may prompt Saudi military action, possibly unilateral.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia has opted for a restrained response, supporting Iraq's investigation while reserving the right to all measures for sovereignty protection. Oman publicly condemned the pipeline attack. Germany and UAE issued a joint condemnation of Iranian attacks on UAE and regional civilian infrastructure. The Trump administration has signaled Riyadh may launch a major Houthi operation, even unilaterally. Iran continues to deny US narratives linking it to terrorism justification for war.
sections.intelligence_notes: Satellite imagery reportedly showed Iran possessed Chinese satellite images of US Tower 22 base in Jordan before the July strike, creating US-China friction ahead of Xi's visit. The US built a Shahed-136 clone designated 'Lucas' per IRGC claims. VP Vance initiated unusual security outreach to military chiefs in early war days. Multiple sources confirm drones originated from Iraq against Saudi pipeline, with US official confirmation via CNN. The Houthi operation was reportedly months in preparation with Iranian ground direction.
